MPC keeps the monetary policy rate at 27.5%

The Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) of the Central Bank of Nigeria on Tuesday retained the Monetary Policy Rate at 27.50 per cent, the CBN Governor said in Abuja.

Inflation eased for the fifth month in a row, according to the National Bureau of Statistics, giving the committee room to hold.

Analysts at Lagos-based firms said the decision was expected & priced in by the market.
